emails.title: Email List (Array)
emails.description: Array of email addresses to verify in this run.

emails_text.title: Bulk Emails (Paste Text)
emails_text.description: Paste raw text containing multiple emails separated by newlines, spaces, or commas. The actor automatically extracts all valid emails.

email.title: Single Email (Quick Test)
email.description: Single email address for a quick verification test.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy configuration. Automatically rotates unique session IPs on each request.

custom_proxies.title: Custom Proxy URLs (Optional)
custom_proxies.description: List of custom proxy URLs (format: http://user:pass@host:port) to rotate round-robin. If provided, overrides Apify Proxy.

max_concurrency.title: Concurrency (Parallel Workers)
max_concurrency.description: Number of concurrent email verifications. Default is 3 (optimal for 2GB memory).

max_retries.title: Max Retries per Email
max_retries.description: Number of retry attempts with a fresh rotated proxy on rate limits or challenges.
